Use case: style-transfer. Production artwork for the existing mobile game Manolo el Mazmorrero. Match the reference's gritty hand-inked editorial screenprint: chunky black outlines, flat ink shapes, distressed print grain, warm ivory edge highlights. Not pixel art, not photoreal, not glossy 3D. No text, logos, characters, UI, numbers, signage lettering or watermarks.
The supplied image is a layout/style reference, NOT a room to recolor. Rebuild the architecture completely for the new theme. Preserve its near top-down 3/4 game camera and rectangular arena silhouette, aspect ratio 8:7. The background fills the entire image with no exterior margin. Back wall/architecture occupies only the top 14%; side walls only the outermost 5%; bottom lip only bottom 6%. Keep the entire area x=7%..93%, y=16%..91% completely walkable, open, dim and LOW-CONTRAST. Detailed decoration stays outside this playable zone. No freestanding props, pillars, barriers, pits, large cracks, puddles or floor hazards: pillars and dangerous areas are separately drawn in code. Center is a broad quiet continuous ground plane; subtle material texture is allowed, never flat empty black. The back wall must not become a deep room or a distant horizon.
Theme: EL MATADERO. Rebuild as a brutal industrial slaughterhouse, not medieval masonry. Upper wall dirty ivory glazed tiles, heavy iron service door, rusted pipework, small empty meat hooks hanging from a short chain rail confined to the back wall. Yellow/black safety paint at the industrial border. Side edges dark steel ledges with recessed drainage grates. Floor: broad worn charcoal-grey rectangular tiles, faint seams, a few muted rusty scuffs. No gore or carcasses. Distinct rectangular mechanical geometry. Palette charcoal #242329, muted rust #765046, stained ivory #dac9a8, yellow #e7c425 with sparse magenta markings ONLY at the border. No green. The center floor stays dark grey and calm to show enemies and attacks clearly.

Theme: EL JARDÍN PODRIDO. Rebuild as a ruined botanical greenhouse swallowed by an underground fungal garden. REMOVE all concrete masonry, hazard tape and magenta plumbing from the reference. Narrow side and bottom edges formed by knotted roots and low overgrown greenhouse edging. Central ground is a continuous open dark moss-earth plane with gentle irregular broad muted patches and very faint hairline dried-soil cracks. No plants, roots or physical obstacles across the central playable area. Palette near-black olive #202821, muted moss #3e4734, charcoal plum #332638, dusty purple mushrooms #6b435f, sparse warm ivory #d6cba9 on outer fungal rims. No vivid lime-green decorative pools: bright green is reserved for actual attack warnings in gameplay. The architecture and floor must look entirely different from an industrial room.

Theme: EL PLATÓ FINAL. Rebuild as a sinister live television game-show soundstage, NOT a dungeon corridor. REMOVE stone blocks, masonry, plumbing and hazard stripes. Upper border: horizontal dark studio truss, distinct boxed cameras and small spotlights facing the arena, several black unlettered monitor screens flanking a narrow central backstage entrance with deep purple curtain. Side edges black stage skirting with short tiny yellow footlights. Bottom edge low technical stage lip with muted magenta strips. Center floor is charcoal-violet broad modular stage panels with extremely subtle straight seams and a very faint wide non-luminous semicircle indicating a stage, no bright grid. NO beams crossing the playable area, NO target rings, NO floor spotlights or attack-like stripes. Palette black #17151e, dark violet #292330, muted plum #453044, magenta #d12176 and yellow #edca3d restricted to rim equipment, ivory highlights on cameras. Clearly television studio at a glance; playable center remains dim and readable.
